periods.time: vol-15 ch-003, immediately after the war opening
periods.summary: Ikki turns a fatal fall and a giant child's ambush into a flawless nonlethal victory over B.B.
periods.cause: Naseem's opening sandstorm throws Ikki high into the air; B.B., fighting to protect Or-Gaule, tries to crush the falling Ikki before he can regroup.
periods.process: Ikki uses his student uniform jacket as a makeshift parachute and B.B.'s handclap wind pressure to cancel his fall, landing on the giant's hand and then the ground. He first tries to intimidate and persuade B.B., believing him only a manipulated child. B.B. resists because he sees Or-Gaule as his friend, so Ikki acknowledges his will and fights seriously. Ikki exploits the gaps created by B.B.'s enormous size, hides in bodily depressions that the giant cannot compress, and uses the giant's slow tracking against him. He cuts the Achilles tendons, then knee tendons, and finally strikes the temple with Secret Sword Rhino Strike to disrupt motor control.
periods.outcome: B.B. collapses, shrinks back to child size, and falls unconscious without lethal injury. Ikki comforts him and entrusts him to League medical personnel.
periods.aftermath: Vermillion viewers and the announcer are shocked by Ikki's perfect victory; Ikki moves toward the remaining battlefields.
periods.significance: Gives Vermillion the first clear win, shows Ikki's tactical superiority against impossible size, and humanizes B.B. as a child soldier rather than a simple monster.
